content:
tomas: Heads-up: we have two arrivals today 11:30 - vendor (CanvasCo) delivering a framed mural, oversized crate; and 11:45 a new parent visitor (Ava) bringing a small bassinet + car seat. Need badge, loading dock to lobby plan, and a short seat near reception.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor scheduled: Ava (guest of jules) ETA 11:45, 1 adult + baby gear. Delivery scheduled: CanvasCo crate ETA 11:30, courier: ParcelPro. Check-in links: https://intranet/checkin/def456

cecilia: Thanks. Two quick notes: 1) Oversized crate needs the service elevator and 2 people to wheel it through. 2) Bassinet is fine but please avoid blocking the lactation/parent room.

mira: Courier can drop at loading dock and our porter (Liam) can bring crate up at 11:35. I'll reserve the service elevator 11:30:50. Also reserving a short bench by reception for the parent.

jules: Appreciate it. Ava asked if she can store the bassinet in a small locker during the demo; it's foldable and listed dims 85x45x40cm. Is that OK?

ops: Locker availability: Guest locker B2 free 11:30:30. Ops ok to badge-lock it for a guest. BUT note: crate needs an escort and dolly; please ensure crate is dry (no wet paint).

cecilia: I'll add instructions to front desk: please verify crate bill of lading, note "dry goods only", and confirm the mural is to be hung by facilities later. For the bassinet: verify it's folded dims and print badge note "bassinet in B2 locker".

tomas: Also two bonus curveballs: CanvasCo says the mural has a fragile glass panel; courier asked about leaving it in lobby temporarily for the host to sign acceptance. Can we keep it upright somewhere safe?

mira: We can put it in the staff stair landing behind a cone for 20min max but better if Facilities brings two people to move it directly to conference 4 where host will inspect. Facilities team is on standby at 11:40.

frontdesk-bot: Reminder to staff: please do not let the crate block the main corridor or the accessible ramp. If Ava needs extra space for the stroller, mark the bench and keep the path clear.

jules: Quick request re: baby food and packages  Ava may have a small refrigerated jar. Can front desk accept perishable jars?

ops: Small sealed baby food jars ok in common fridge. Please label with guest name and put in a marked box. For fragile glass mural, Facilities will move it straight to conference 4 and keep it upright on A-frame.

cecilia: Adding a 4-step check-in snippet to playbook for today:
1) Courier: confirm BOL, escort to service elevator, note "fragile glass" on delivery log.
2) Guest: verify ID, print badge with note "bassinet in B2 locker".
3) If perishable present: place in common fridge in labeled guest box.
4) If oversized crate present: Facilities escort for upstairs move; do not leave crate unattended in lobby.

jules: Perfect. I'll message both guests/courier with the plan and confirm ETA. Thanks team :heart: 

mira: PSA: if anyone schedules a visitor with a folded stroller/bassinet in future, please include folded dimensions in the invite so we can pre-assign locker or bench. Saves a scramble. :pray:
